sideB.text:
DAR ES SALAAM

Yellow city art with a white upgrade panel and a green ring. No other text.

rules: Yellow Infection card for Dar es Salaam. Same face as P7-09b except the printed code.
The white center panel is the infection-card upgrade slot.
notes: Printed P7-10b, not a duplicate of the P7-09b code.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
